description: Rule-based 1 to 5 score of distribution defensibility, using only the acquisition channels you list and whether you have proprietary data or network effects. business_model is echoed back and does not change the score. It is a discussion aid built from Mode VC's published thesis, not a valuation, not an investment decision and not a prediction.

acquisition_channels.description: Key distribution channels. Channels containing hardware_bundle, network_lockin, viral_loop, system_default or native_integration raise the score.

has_proprietary_data_or_network.description: Does user activity generate compounding data or network lock-in?

product_name.description: Name of the startup or product

name: get_distribution_moat_score
title: Distribution Moat Score (rule-based heuristic)
